div.p: A unique identifier to name a specific element within an EAS instance.

An identifier that must be unique within the current EAS instance and is used to name the element so that it can be referred to from somewhere else in the EAS instance. This facilitates building links between the element and other elements within the same XML file, though it can also be used to point to a specific element from outside of the EAS instance.
Use target, conventionDeclarationReference, localTypeDeclarationReference, maintenanceEventReference, or sourceReference to link to an id attribute within the EAS instance.

div.egXML: <occupations> <occupation> <term>Assistant examiner - level III</term> <placeName target="#place1">Bern</placeName> </occupation> </occupations> <places> <place id="place1"> <label>Bern</label> <role>Place of work</role> <address> <addressLine addressLineType="street">Stauffacherstrasse 65/59g</addressLine> <addressLine addressLineType="postalCode">3003</addressLine> <addressLine addressLineType="municipality">Bern</addressLine> </address> </place> </places>

<agents> <agent> <label>Schweizerisches Bundesarchiv</label> <role>holdingInstitution</role> <placeName target="#place1">Bern</placeName> </agent> </agents> <places> <place id="place1"> <label>Bern</label> <role>Place of storage</role> <address> <addressLine addressLineType="street">Archivstrasse 24</addressLine> <addressLine addressLineType="postalCode">3005</addressLine> <addressLine addressLineType="municipality">Bern</addressLine> </address> </place> </places>
